scope: Engineering replay of the published MCQ selections. Each valid letter becomes one observed slot. Confidence is fixed. Only reading count is evaluated. No live OCR or team course cases.
split: Deterministic SHA-256 order of drift-v1/ followed by the published exam ID. First 30 provide the reference. The same remaining 20 form both comparison windows.
shift: Withhold detections from Q16 through Q20.
sensitivity: 100 overlapping deterministic 30/20 repartitions of the same 50 exams. Both methods use the same alert threshold. The candidate adds half an observation per possible bin.
